templates.title: Ethora Core
templates.description: Self-hosted chat and messaging server: API, web chat and admin panel, XMPP server (ejabberd with the Ethora modules), MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, MinIO, Centrifugo, with Caddy for TLS. Free edition, no license key. Point api., app., xmpp. and files.<root domain> at the host first, or use <ip-with-dashes>.sslip.io as the root domain.
templates.note: After deployment, sign in at https://app.<root domain> with the admin e-mail and password you set. Licence: https://ethora.com/legal/ethora-core-license/ . Documentation: https://github.com/dappros/ethora-install/tree/main/deploy/compose
